timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026, Concord Enviro announced that its wholly owned overseas subsidiary Concord Enviro FZE acquired a 2.87% stake in WaHa Inc. for US$ 574,999.65.
On 28 April 2026, Concord Enviro held a court-convened meeting of equity shareholders pursuant to NCLT directions to consider a Scheme of Arrangement.
ICRA submitted the IPO Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹130.85 Cr utilised out of ₹175 Cr fresh issue proceeds with no material deviation.
Promoter group (Prayas Goel, Prerak Goel, and 44 entities) disclosed 51.43% stake (106,442,800 shares) in Concord Enviro Systems, with no encumbrances as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹206.04 Cr, net profit ₹14.15 Cr.
Concord Enviro released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26 on May 22, 2026, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹557.86 Cr.
On May 28, 2026, Concord Enviro Systems filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 25, 2026.
Rochem Separation Systems secured a ₹126 Cr order from a major steel manufacturer for ZLD systems to be executed over 18 months.
Concord Enviro subsidiary Rochem won a ₹16 Cr ZLD order from a rail engineering company to be executed over 28 weeks.
Concord Enviro Systems Limited will host an Earnings Conference Call on 4th November 2026 at 09:30 AM IST to discuss Q2 & H1 FY27 results.
